section.title: Introduction and Overview
section.p: In order that tool sprites may be cached by hardware drivers the Window Manager will now issue a service to allow the drivers to uncache old data.

service-definition.name: WimpToolSpritesChanged
service-definition.description: The Tool sprite area has changed

use.p: This service is issued by the WindowManager when the Tool sprite area is changed.
